query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.userType, u.loginMethod
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON u.id = mp.userId
WHERE mp.id IS NULL AND u.userType = 'high_school_student'
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
